'''2005 World Championship Day 2 Drew Scott DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Drew Scott]] at [[2005 World Championship]] (Day 2); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Michael "mc9457" Carr (2005-09-28).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35179 Worlds Day 2 - Drew Scott's BHBM]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071213225136/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35179 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Worlds Day 2 - Drew Scott's BHBM'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "mc9457" Carr
* '''Published:''' September 28, 2005
* '''Rating:''' 4.25
* '''Description:''' Deck Drew Scott used to top 8 in day 2. Bring Him Before Me in all its glory.

=== Strategy ===

<nowiki/>* Swap around starting effects depending on what you see.

Lots of battling.  Negate their EPPs.  Capture Luke.  Direct damage and decent drains.

Drew used this deck to top 8 at Worlds 2005 in Day 2.
